list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(render): add ArmorHUD module
- Armor slots (helmet -> boots) + main/offhand, rendered via vanilla ItemRenderer with enchant glint and 3D models - Totem counter (incl. offhand, red when 0) and gapple counter (purple when enchanted apples present) - Durability: bar + remaining units, green->red color by ratio - Top-priority enchantment label per slot (Prot > Proj > Blast > ...) - 6 anchor positions with X/Y offset fine-tuning, horizontal/vertical layouts, configurable item scale - "Низ центр" default sits above hotbar/hearts without overlapping - 3-pass rendering (background -> items -> text), safe GL state handling, error counter with auto-disable

task.summary:
Fix NameTagItem interaction logic
- Moved return statement inside the inner if block so ActionResultType is only returned when the target is alive and not on a client world - Changed return value to func_233537_a_(false) since we already verify !isRemote - Added else clause to return PASS when target is not alive or on client world

fix(render): fix Nametags visual rendering
- Fix unreadable font size (scale*50 produced ~1.5px text) - Fix drawRect: use MatrixStack matrix, POSITION_COLOR format, reset GL state after rendering (was breaking subsequent draws) - Remove unsupported §-color codes from rendered text - Replace "Масштаб" slider with "Размер шрифта" (pixel-based) - Render health as colored bar + value next to name - Implement armor bar (setting was unused before) - Compact info line: distance / ping / invisibility - Add null-check for mc.getConnection() before ping lookup - Sort entities far-to-near, skip off-screen tags

fix(render): fix Nametags visual rendering
- Fix unreadable font size (scale*50 produced ~1.5px text) - Fix drawRect: use MatrixStack matrix, POSITION_COLOR format, reset GL state after rendering (was breaking subsequent draws) - Remove unsupported §-color codes from rendered text - Replace "Масштаб" slider with "Размер шрифта" (pixel-based) - Render health as colored bar + value next to name - Implement armor bar (setting was unused before) - Compact info line: distance / ping / invisibility - Add null-check for mc.getConnection() before ping lookup - Sort entities far-to-near, skip off-screen tags
Removed unused SkeletonESP because I think it useless

fix(render): fix Chams crashing the game
- Fix crash: IRenderTypeBuffer wrapper was never finished, leaving the shared Tessellator buffer in "building" state -> vanilla's next begin() threw "Already building" IllegalStateException - Replace broken model rendering with projected 2D hitbox boxes (PlayerModel in GUI overlay matrix could never be visible anyway) - Reset RenderSystem color after drawing (screen color got stuck) - Interpolate hitbox position for smooth rendering - Clamp off-screen boxes, cull fully invisible players - Reuse one begin/draw batch for all players instead of per-player - Safe GL state save/restore + error counter with auto-disable after 50 failures (prevents hard crash instead of kicking to desktop) - Sort far-to-near so closer boxes draw on top

fix(render): repair Nametags, HoleESP and Chams modules
Nametags: - Fix unreadable font size (scale*50 produced ~1.5px text) - Fix drawRect: use MatrixStack matrix, POSITION_COLOR format, reset GL state after rendering - Strip unsupported §-color codes from rendered text - Replace "Масштаб" slider with pixel-based "Размер шрифта" setting - Render health as colored bar + value next to name, add armor bar - Compact info line (distance / ping / invisibility) - Null-safe ping lookup, far-to-near sorting, off-screen culling
HoleESP: - Fix boxes being invisible: world-space DisplayUtils rendering never worked in the 2D POST overlay; switched to ProjectionUtil-based projected rendering - Fix hole classification: bedrock floor + obsidian walls is a safe obsidian hole, not unsafe - Throttle scanning to once per 5 ticks, circular scan area - fillAlpha only affects fill, outline uses full color alpha - Auto-detect projection coordinate space (GUI vs framebuffer) - Debug setting: chat stats + test overlay
Chams: - Fix crash: IRenderTypeBuffer wrapper was never finished, leaving the shared Tessellator buffer in "building" state -> "Already building" IllegalStateException on next frame - Replace broken PlayerModel rendering (invisible in GUI matrix) with projected 2D hitbox boxes (fill + wireframe) - Reset stuck RenderSystem color, interpolate hitbox position - Error counter with auto-disable after repeated failures instead of hard crash
Shared: safe GL state save/restore (depth, cull, depthMask, blend, line width) across all three modules.
change .gitignore add screenshots directory and restore loader_version.json

fix(render): fix LogoutSpots not working
- Fix detection: EventEntityLeave fired on ANY entity removal (render distance, dimension change), not only logouts. Replaced with world+tablist comparison: player gone from world AND tablist = logout; gone from world but still in tablist = just out of render distance (10s timeout) - NPC detection: players without a server list entry are ignored (no false spots from fake players) - Spot removed + chat message when logged-out player rejoins - Fix rendering: world-space DisplayUtils boxes were invisible in the 2D POST overlay (same issue as HoleESP); switched to ProjectionUtil projected rendering (fill + outline) - Fix text: NPE when projection returns null, unreadable 0.5f font size, unrenderable §-color codes replaced with per-segment colors - Safe GL state save/restore, error counter with auto-disable

feat(render): add ArmorHUD module
